_comment: Coverage floors enforced by scripts/check-coverage.ts (warren-e4b1, pl-7b06 step 17). Set just below the current baseline to absorb measurement noise. The ratchet only goes UP — raise these numbers as coverage improves. Exception: warren-b8bf (pl-3a79 step 8) deleted ~7.4k LOC of well-tested plot code, moving the lines baseline from 92.73% to ~91.96% and functions to 89.33%; both floors lowered accordingly. warren-ba08 ratchet: floors raised to the suggested 90.91/93.37 after the ref-dispatch no_changes path landed. namphuongtran/warren#15: the Bun 1.3.14 -> 1.4.5 upgrade changed how Bun counts coverage. The unchanged suite measures 92.59% functions / 92.45% lines on 1.4.5 (91.68% / 93.47% on 1.3.14), so functions rises to 92.49 and lines re-baselines to 92.35. No tests were removed.
